criteria.evidence: scripts/speck.mjs: cmdSet and shipTicket call placeTicket to relocate tickets according to status. Supplied passing tests cover setting done, reopening, preserving the filename and timestamp, and committing the move during ship.

The supplied findTicket implementation searches both folders; listTickets includes both for status and nextId. Passing integration tests exercise archived tickets through set, lint, pack and reviewer-settings, verify status still lists them, and verify new allocates the next number.

cmdInit migrates live-folder tickets whose status is done using placeTicket. Passing tests cover migration, repeat init, leaving draft tickets untouched, and refusing a destination collision while preserving both copies.

findings.issue: Init previously could overwrite an archived ticket when the same filename existed in both folders. The new destination check in placeTicket prevents that overwrite, and the regression test exercises distinct copies and verifies both survive.
findings.suggested_fix: Implemented: destination collision guard and regression coverage.

product_md.note: The supplied product.md and docs/brief.md describe the done folder, reopening, migration, continued lookup and collision refusal consistently with the supplied code.

verdict.summary: Finished tickets are filed away, reopened tickets return to the live folder, and commands continue to find archived work. The overwrite risk is fixed, with regression coverage. All 37 supplied tests pass. Approval is based on the supplied diffs and test output; independent repository access remains blocked by the sandbox startup failure.
